en.text: Meet Inertia Localize. Laravel translations, anywhere.
Most Inertia apps keep translations twice: PHP for Laravel, JSON for the frontend. They drift apart, and keys go missing.
Inertia Localize keeps Laravel as your single source of truth.
Translations are shared as an Inertia prop on every response. Your React or Vue adapter reads it, and you just call t().
en.speak: Translations are shared as an Inertia prop on every response. Your React or Vue adapter reads it, and you just call tee.

en.text: Setup takes thirty seconds: install the package and your adapter, publish the config, pick your locales, and register the locale route.
In your pages, just call t(). To switch locale, call setLocale: the session and the i18n prop update, and the page follows.
en.speak: In your pages, just call tee. To switch locale, call set locale: the session and the i18n prop update, and the page follows.

en.text: Minimal integration. A type-safe API. One source of truth.
And it ships skills for your AI coding agent.
Inertia Localize: keep Laravel as your source of truth. Open source, MIT licensed.
